chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Ash'ary, from Ibn al-Qaddah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), when he drank milk, would say: 'O Allah, bless us in it and increase us from it.'
ai.seo_question: What is the supplication to recite after drinking milk according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi’s chapter on dairy, this hadith highlights the Prophet’s specific dhikr for milk, reflecting the Shia emphasis on sanctifying daily nourishment through prophetic tradition. It underscores the theological view that sustenance is a divine trust, encouraging believers to seek not just physical benefit but spiritual barakah in ordinary acts like eating and drinking.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Al Ash’ary, from Ibn Al Qaddah, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Whenever the Prophet<sup>saww</sup> drank the milk, said: ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Bless for us in it, and Increase for us from it’.
en.sarwar: 3. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Ash‘ariy from ibn al-Qaddah who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause,
when drinking milk would say, ‘O Lord, make it a blessing for us and increase it for us.’”
